Class GuiRenderer

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.is25am31.view.gui.GuiRenderer
All Implemented Interfaces:
UiRenderer
public class GuiRenderer extends Object implements UiRenderer
Singleton implementation of the UiRenderer interface for JavaFX-based GUI rendering. Serves as the bridge between the game logic and the JavaFX UI, handling all UI updates and user interactions. Ensures thread-safe UI updates using Platform.runLater and manages the various game phase transitions and visual updates.
